# Official examples

These are FrSky's own example scripts from [ETHOS-Feedback-Community](https://github.com/FrSkyRC/ETHOS-Feedback-Community/tree/HEAD/lua/examples), copied here so you can read and search them alongside the API reference. API pages link back here under **Used in**.

| Example | Type | What it shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [active-look](active-look.md) | Script | Drive ActiveLook smart glasses (`glasses` namespace). |
| [bluetooth](bluetooth.md) | System tool | Scan and connect Bluetooth devices (`bluetooth` namespace). |
| [custom-sensor](custom-sensor.md) | Sensor | Create a telemetry sensor whose value is computed in Lua. |
| [layout](layout.md) | Layout | Register a custom screen layout (`system.registerLayout`). |
| [lazy-loading](lazy-loading.md) | Widget | Keep startup RAM small by loading tool/widget code on first use. |
| [memstatus](memstatus.md) | Task | Background task that prints Lua and bitmap RAM every few seconds. |
| [source](source.md) | Source | Register a Lua source that other parts of the model can use. |
| [task](task.md) | Task | Minimal background task (`system.registerTask`). |
| [theme](theme.md) | Theme | Register a custom color theme. |
| [tool-form](tool-form.md) | System tool | System tool built from form fields. |
| [tool-servo](tool-servo.md) | System tool | System tool that drives a servo channel. |
| [widget-flvss](widget-flvss.md) | Widget | Widget showing FLVSS LiPo cell voltages. |
| [widget-form](widget-form.md) | Widget | Widget with a configuration form and persistent settings. |
| [widget-gauge](widget-gauge.md) | Widget | Gauge widget with configurable source and colors. |
| [widget-jet](widget-jet.md) | Widget | Jet turbine dashboard using bitmap dials. |
| [widget-lcddemo](widget-lcddemo.md) | Widget | Tour of the `lcd` drawing API. |
| [widget-rssi](widget-rssi.md) | Widget | Classic RSSI bar widget. |
| [widget-sinus](widget-sinus.md) | Widget | The smallest useful widget: draws a sine wave. |
| [wizard](wizard.md) | Script | Model setup wizard built with forms. |
| [xxxxl](xxxxl.md) | Widget | Large-text value widget. |
